title: Does It Hold the Center? | AMC 10-Style Level 4
description:
Pick four of the 13 corners of a regular 13-sided polygon. How often does the quadrilateral hold the center? Vantee shows a neat trick: count the misses and subtract.
A miss fits in half the circle, so count each one by its first vertex. Then check it a second way with the big gap, spot the common traps, and try an 11-sided version yourself.
